station.name: Lewisham – Honor Oak Park
station.provider: London Air Quality Network / Imperial College London

periodBasis: UTC calendar year; local times are available using the stated time zone

quality.seasonalEligibilityRule: At least 75% valid hourly readings in every UTC calendar month
quality.sourceTimestamps: RData POSIXct instants converted to GMT, as required by openair::importImperial(); no summer-time shift
quality.sourcePrecisionNote: PM2.5 values serialized to three decimal places; original annual response retained by hash
quality.license: Open Government Licence v2; London Air Quality Network / Imperial College London
quality.licenseEvidence: LondonAir network API documentation specifies OGL v2; the annual RData object does not embed a separate license statement
quality.ratificationStatus: Not provided in the annual RData archive; no ratification claim is made
quality.selectionReason: Urban-background monitor with at least 75% valid data in every month; HP1 has 99.90% annual capture
quality.spatialScope: One urban-background monitor; not a citywide or population-weighted estimate
